job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
Job title: AI & Automation Engineer / AI Developer - Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI
Day Rate: £350 per day - Outside IR35 / Ltd Company
Location: Fully remote / WFH
Duration: 3 months initially
Start Date: ASAP

Role
We are recruiting an experienced AI Engineer / AI Developer to join our client's team on an initial 3 month contract, supporting the development and delivery of AI-powered applications, agents and business process automation solutions.

Working alongside a technical lead, you will take a hands-on role in building, integrating, testing and deploying AI solutions using Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry).

This opportunity will best suit a hands-on AI Engineer, AI Developer, Technical Consultant or Automation Specialist with practical experience building and implementing AI solutions. You will combine strong technical delivery skills with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective AI applications and automated workflows.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop AI agents, applications and automated workflows using Microsoft Foundry.
  • Build and integrate AI solutions with existing business systems, APIs and data sources.
  • Develop and maintain code using Python or C#.
  • Configure AI models, prompts, knowledge retrieval and agent workflows.
  • Test, troubleshoot and deploy AI solutions, ensuring reliability, security and performance.
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Produce technical documentation and support handover to internal teams.
Essential Skills & Experience
  • Minimum 2 years' commercial experience delivering AI solutions and business process automation.
  • At least 6 months' hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry.
  • Proven experience building and implementing AI agents, applications or automated workflows.
  • Strong software development skills using Python or C#.
  • Experience integrating applications and business systems using REST APIs and JSON.
  • Experience with Git, testing, troubleshooting and secure data handling.
  • Ability to work independently and demonstrate examples of AI solutions personally developed and delivered.
Desirable Skills
  • Azure OpenAI and Generative AI technologies.
  • Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps or Azure Functions.
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Azure AI Search.
  • Microsoft 365 or SharePoint integrations.
  • Experience delivering AI solutions within enterprise environments.

job.title: Rubrik Backup Engineer
job.description:
Job title: Rubrik Backup Engineer
Day Rate: £400 to 450 per day - Outside IR35
Duration: 3-6 months initially
Location: Fully remote / WFH
Start Date: ASAP

Role
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Rubrik / Commvault Backup Engineer to support a fast-paced Rubrik rollout across VMware and Azure environments, migrating workloads from Commvault while maintaining business-as-usual backup operations.

This is a delivery-focused role requiring someone who can hit the ground running, work independently and collaborate effectively with international IT teams, so excellent communication skills are essential.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deploy and configure Rubrik Edge for on-premises VMware and Rubrik Cloud Cluster for Azure workloads.
  • Migrate backup protection from Commvault to Rubrik, ensuring retention, recovery and service continuity.
  • Configure backup policies, schedules and retention, validating protection through restore testing.
  • Troubleshoot backup failures, resolve technical issues and provide BAU support across both platforms.
  • Coordinate deployments with IT teams across the UK, EMEA and APAC.
  • Track rollout progress, manage blockers and maintain clear technical documentation and handover records.
Essential Experience
  • Strong hands-on Rubrik experience, including Rubrik Edge, VMware and Azure Cloud Cluster deployments.
  • Proven Commvault administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience migrating workloads between enterprise backup platforms.
  • Solid VMware and Azure infrastructure knowledge.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across backup, storage, networking and infrastructure.
  • Ability to work independently, deliver at pace and communicate clearly with stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills and a positive can-do approach
Desirable
  • Experience delivering infrastructure projects across international sites.
  • Background in pharmaceutical, manufacturing or regulated environments.
  • Relevant Rubrik, Commvault, VMware or Azure certifications.
